protocol.search: Same C79copula/empirical bank4096scenarios,all ranked prefixes initialization,at most8single-bit improving moves,min_step1e-6,prefer removal/linkID on tie. Not globally optimal.
protocol.conditional_MC_validation: Separate fit-template banks seeds20261107/20261119,2048each. Accept proposal iff paired simulation mean gain>=.001 and approximate normal95CI lower>0. This is model-law numerical screening,not real label/test confidence.
protocol.source_data: Only existing fit labels/masks to build independent simulation bank;decision features/labels for screen. Frozen trees,calibrators,incumbent/rawthreshold/nonempty/prefix controls. No selection/assessment arrays read by worker.
protocol.screen_gate: Shortlist validated_local only if decision proxy>=incumbent+.005 and>=prefix+.005. If no case qualifies,stop this decoder expansion;do not evaluate new selection/assessment. If any qualifies,a separate frozen followup protocol is needed.
protocol.scope: Previously viewed public noisy observation proxies;not blind/final/private. Actual future labels/masks only score completed decisions. No tuning maxmoves/MCseeds/margins.
